metric: abs Spearman with developmental stage (mean over seeds)
note: CellRank fate probability and the committor both estimate probability of reaching Beta, scored on recovering developmental stage (mean over 3 seeds, 150 cells). The committor (0.93) matches PC1 (0.92) and is far more stable than CellRank fate-to-Beta (0.61, high variance). FAIRNESS CAVEAT: 150 cells with a proxy velocity is a small, non-ideal regime for CellRank's GPCCA fate estimation, which needs more cells; CellRank's high variance here likely reflects that, not a general weakness. A fairer head-to-head would use a larger dataset. This pipeline additionally provides the entropy-production test and kT barrier CellRank does not compute.
